caption: The drawing shows a sculptural object placed centrally on the page with soft and neutral background shading, leaving most of the surrounding area empty. The object consists of two main figures on a shared base. On the left is a person with brown skin, seated cross-legged, facing right, and holding a rope or rein that is connected to a standing animal on the right. The animal, which appears to be a horse, is brown in color with darker shading on its mane, tail, and lower legs, and is adorned with harnesses that have red and black details. The base is an elongated, irregular platform shaded in brown tones with some darker edges, and follows the figures' outlines. The person's garment and the animal's harness are highlighted in places with red and black, and the person holds a thin stick-like object. Faint, unfinished red outline sketches of the same or similar scene repeat in four smaller forms around the main drawing, positioned toward the bottom and sides of the page.
title: Toy Bank: Mule
